workingTitle: لماذا تقول نعم… وأنت تريد أن تقول لا؟

formula.book: توقف عن إرضاء الآخرين — باتريك كينغ
formula.idea: الموافقة خوفًا من ردّ الفعل تسبق مراجعة القدرة
formula.problem: تقول «حاضر» لطلب غير عاجل وأنت تريد أن تقول «لا»، فيذهب المساء المحجوز لمشروعك

situation: رسالة زميل غير عاجلة «ممكن تساعدني اليوم؟» ومساء محجوز للمشروع الشخصي (مثال افتراضي)
promise: يرى المشاهد لماذا خرجت «حاضر» قبل أن تصبح قراره، ويجرّب ثلاث خطوات على الرسالة نفسها.

duration.rule: the measured recording decides; no padding with silence, no speed or pitch change
duration.note: below range: the full take ran ~125 wpm over 432 words; only purposeful holds were added (see timeline.json addedBeats)

palette: palette.json (identity 5 + aqua and cardboard from the Arabic edition's cover); no fixed yellow or orange
rules: Arabic only inside the picture, digits 0–9
words animate as whole units; typed text fills a whole word at a time
no book cover image in the video; an original kraft-paper book card
helping is not the problem; fear of the reaction is a possibility, not a diagnosis
a clear reply does not guarantee everyone's approval; not every request is exploitation
no therapy claims, statistics or brain terms
the reference video (Bookaffeine) is not copied and was not watched

voice.direction: [warmly] [calmly] audio tags at the start of the text (not spoken)
voice.softening: audio/softening-chain.txt (gentle EQ + light de-esser) applied to a copy of the take before alignment
voice.policy: one opening sample → owner approval → one full take; generation text built by tools/build_prompts.py and verified identical (SHA-256) before estimate and generation

references: claude-fikra-02-people-pleasing.md (owner's production brief); creative direction and episode-1 feedback from the owner
